name: 28306 · Fayetteville, NC
findings: ZIP 28306 (Fayetteville) has 132 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28306 (Fayetteville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 27 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: 2 social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 8 would.
